name: Proofing
summary: Bakery sign-in: a sleepy dough rises as you type, naps under a tea towel and bakes golden when you get in
about: A full sign-in page for a Lahore neighbourhood bakery, with the form on a scalloped order card beside a morning kitchen: a blue-pottery bowl of dough, a brick oven with live flames, a chalkboard menu, a kitchen timer and flour dust drifting in the sun beam. The dough wakes up and rises with every letter of your email, naps under a striped tea towel while you type the password and sinks with a sad face on a wrong one. Signing in bakes it golden with steam, sparkles and a ringing timer.
how: Watch the demo bake a loaf by itself, then click any field to take over
Type an email: the dough wakes, rises and grows bubbles, and the timer dial turns
Click the password: a tea towel drops over the bowl; the eye button lifts a corner for a peek
Try a wrong password to sink the dough, or use Fill it in (ayesha@proofing.pk, sourdough8) to bake it
Open an account counts password rules as loaves; the reset code is 581204
